findings.statement: The intent's decided form of delivery - a web page the player asks for and sees the number on - has no criterion at all: every one of the five criteria constrains the value or forbids a side effect, and all five would pass against a bare data payload that no player can read as a page, so the outcome build implements and verify checks never includes the page itself.
findings.locus: ## Acceptance criteria, criterion 1 - its "Answers to: ... § Fixed decisions, bullet 1" claims coverage the criterion does not deliver
findings.remedy: Add a criterion for the delivery itself: a request a player can make with a browser returns a document the browser renders as a page, and the rolled value is visible in what it renders - checked by requesting it, asserting the response is served as an HTML document, and asserting the roll appears in the rendered content, so a response carrying only a data payload fails. Then correct criterion 1's "Answers to" line to cite only the outcome it actually tests, the value being one number from 1 to 6.
